title: Self-organising maps of EEM data
text: EEMs need excitation emission wavelengths. recommend removing interpolating scattering PARAFAC analysis, otherwise Raman Rayleigh scattering dominate map. , wavelengths additionally reduced range PARAFAC model pf4 staRdom. staRdom functions useful step: eem_range() cuts EEMs range wavelengths. eem_red2smallest() eem_extend2largest() bring EEMs different wavelengths wavelengths. eem_rem_scat() removes scattering, eem_interp() interpolates removed areas. eem_exclude() removes samples wavelengths.
code: eem_list <- eem_list |>   # same wavelength range as the PARAFAC model pf4   eem_range(ex = c(250, 455), em = c(290, 578)) |>   # remove Raman and Rayleigh scattering of 1st and 2nd order   eem_rem_scat(remove_scatter = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE), remove_scatter_width = c(15, 15, 18, 19)) |>   # interpolate the removed areas   eem_interp(type = 1, extend = FALSE, cores = cores) ggeem(eem_list)
